A '''secret Rebel base''' was located in [[Nym's Stronghold]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the [[Remembrance Day]] celebrations<ref name="SWG:ETTSRCNS" /> of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an [[entertainer]] affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] traveled from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to Nym's Stronghold in order to perform in the Rebel secret base's [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].<ref name="SWG:ETTSRCNS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The secret Rebel base was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ETTSRCNS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The secret Rebel base was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 11|Game Update 11]]," published on [[June 23]], [[2009]], and only appeared during the [[W:c:swg:Empire Day|Empire Day]] events of 2009,<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 11 Empire Day">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=940830|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 11 Empire Day}}</ref> [[2010]]<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 17 - Empire Day VII / Remembrance Day VII">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1100816|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 17 - Empire Day VII / Remembrance Day VII}}</ref> and [[2011]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Hotfix 19.20">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1219548|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Hotfix 19.20}}</ref>
